title: Would like to eat or drink

sections.title: Szeretnék + infinitive
sections.content: To say what you would like to *do*, put the infinitive after *szeretnék*. You know the infinitive from *szoktam olvasni*. Two verbs you need in a café have special infinitives: *eszik → enni* (to eat) and *iszik → inni* (to drink). Learn them as they are. The thing you eat or drink comes before the infinitive and takes *-t*.

sections.title: Only szeretnék changes
sections.content: The person ending sits on *szeretnék / szeretnél / szeretne*. The infinitive never changes: *Szeretnék inni*, *Szeretnél inni?*, *Anna szeretne inni.*

items.english: I would like to drink coffee.
Would you like to eat a pastry?
Anna would like to drink tea.
What would you like to drink?

sections.content: Put the person on *szeretnék*, not on the infinitive: *Szeretnél inni*, never *Szeretnék innél*. The object keeps its *-t*: *kávét inni*.
